preconditions.description: Number of junctions (n) and roads (m) are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects valid junctions within the range [1, n].
No two roads connect the same pair of intersections.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: No road connects an intersection to itself.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'YES' if it's possible to create the routes, or 'NO' otherwise.

postconditions.expression: possible_routes == True if return_value == 'YES' else possible_routes == False
postconditions.description: Variable possible_routes indicates whether the routes are possible.
If routes are possible, there are exactly three routes.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(len(route) >= 3 for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Each route has at least three intersections.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(route[0] == route[-1] for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Each route starts and ends at the same intersection.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(route[0] != route[1] for route in routes)
postconditions.description: The start and finish of each route are different.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(len(set(route)) == len(route) for route in routes)
postconditions.description: No intersection is visited more than once in each route.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(len(set((u, v) for u, v in zip(route, route[1:]))) == len(route) - 1 for route in routes)
postconditions.description: No road is used more than once in each route.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(len(set.intersection(*[set(route) for route in routes])) == 1 for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Only the start and finish intersections are common among all routes.

postconditions.expression: if possible_routes: all(len(set.union(*[set(route) for route in routes])) == n for route in routes)
postconditions.description: All intersections are covered by the routes.
